snippet.title: Hieronymus Gamescom 2025 Trailer: An Action-Adventure Through the Surreal Worlds of Hieronymus Bosch
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2518790/Hieronymus/
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/PEDpqg8W4W

Visit us at Gamescom 2025: Indie Arena Booth, Hall 10.2, Booth  F010g - E019

Explore the weird, surreal worlds of the medieval painter Hieronymus Bosch. Encounter grotesque creatures and make use of a variety of historical weapons and alchemy to unravel your families’ mysteries.

Web: http://www.hieronymus-game.com/
X: https://twitter.com/HieronymusGame
Instagram: https://instagram.com/hieronymus_game?igshid=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==

Music by Hannah Lucia Brosch https://www.instagram.com/eluciaen.wav/
3D Art and animations by Jörn Friedrichs
Programming by Felix Rummel

No Ai "Art" was used.
